formkit.title: FormKit: On Designing Forms for a Living
formkit.description: About eighteen months ago, I was tasked with rebuilding and uplifting all the forms across Insurebot — a system that became known internally as FormKit. What many would consider a rather mundane task turned out to be an excellent opportunity to deep-dive on how to design delightful and powerful forms for power users and novices alike.
